name: Durk Aszkreamer
source:
Durk is an orc hailing from the North East of America. Unlike most orcs, Durk was born into orc nobility. Descended from a long of Aszkreamer's, Durk has inherited a heavy mantle.

While most orcs grunt, smash, play football and end up in jobs in the military as grunts or labor based trades like construction workers. Orcs born into the noble clans lead a much different life. These orcs usually end up achieving high ranks in the military, government or as cut throat business executives. Durk was still even more different, and pursued a career in science. He had always loved nature as a child, enjoying the forests around his family's New England summer home. While other orcs were hunting in the forest, Durk was collecting flower samples, and studying the local fauna.

Durk lead a very sheltered life, he never experienced the more savage joys and burdens that regular orc children were put through. Even more so, since he wasn't the oldest son in his family, even less pressure was put on him to succeed in the more noble orcish tracks. His clothes, his voice, his choice of words and manners... All betrayed any attempt on his part to act like an average orc.

When he entered college, he naturally gravitated toward science, studying nature and natural resource management. After finishing college and graduate school, Durk set out looking for the right job. At first he had trouble finding a job due to his brutish appearance, but soon his intelligence and dedication to nature shined through, and he began working in natural resource management.

He worked his way up through the ranks, but he was so dedicated to his cause that he never had time for a personal life. Sure, his family tried to set him up with arranged dates and prospective brides. Durk managed to rebuff all of them for one reason or another. Some were too arrogant, some were too selfish, and most cared not for being outside like he did. As he passed 40, the demands of his family to get married were growing louder and louder. Durk began desperately to search for an escape.

Fortune smiled on him. He found an ad in a nature magazine for Meat Log Mountain. So far away from his home and the demands to settle down. He took a chance, and interviewed. His qualifications were as impeccable as his clothes, and he soon had the job.

As Durk wandered around the town, shocked at the complete and total lack of women, he wondered: "Was this what he was searching for? Escape from all the demands back home? And how could such a well groomed, civilized orc survive around such burly, brutesque men in their natural habitat?" There are all questions that await to be answered... In Meat Log Mountain.

Statistics:
Weight: 365lbs
Height: 6'2
Cock Size: Very Big
Cock type: Uncut
Occupation: Natural Resources Scientist
